planSteps.description: Create src/utils/FileHandler.js to safely read files, validate paths, and prevent directory traversal attacks
Add sendDocument() method to src/messaging/WhatsAppProvider.js to send file attachments via WhatsApp API
Update src/agents/IntentAgent.js to detect file-send commands (e.g., "send me file /path/to/file")
Create src/agents/FileAgent.js to handle file reading and coordinate file sending via WhatsApp
Modify src/agents/OrchestratorAgent.js to route file-send intents to FileAgent
Update src/messaging/MessagingLayer.js to support file attachment payloads in responses
Add file size limits and access control validation in FileHandler.js for security
